title: A link can open one service directly, and the time picker leads with a month calendar and the first open day

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: /spaces/<slug>/book takes no search params, so an owner cannot share 'book my 60 minute session' the way Calendly shares an event-type link, and Spotlight Link cards cannot deep-link a service. The picker prints every open slot of every day in the window as buttons (a 60 day window of 30 minute slots is hundreds of buttons on a phone). Fix: ?service=<id> preselects; the picker shows a month grid with open days marked, then that day's times.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
